register.labelZh: STARVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: starve for 可以表示某人極度需要安慰、支持、陪伴、資訊或其他並非食物的事物。；starve something of funds、light、water 或 staff,可以清楚表示某事物得不到必要的資金、光線、水分或人手。；starve somebody into doing something 表示有人被斷絕食物、金錢或物資,最後被迫採取某項行動。；starve somebody out 可以表示斷絕食物來源,直至動物、昆蟲或人離開某個地方。
register.summaryEn: Starve for can describe a powerful need for kindness, support, company, information or other things that are not food. Starve something of funds, light, water or staff clearly shows that it is not receiving something necessary. Starve somebody into doing something shows that food, money or supplies have been withheld until the person or group takes a particular action. Starve somebody out can describe removing access to food until animals, insects or people leave a place.
